name: comp-503
title: Calendar With Time Input
description: A single month calendar in a bordered panel, with a divider below and a label reading Enter time. The time field shows hours, minutes and seconds beside a clock icon, and days circle in white when pressed.
use: An event needs both a day and a clock time and you want them in one compact panel.
avoid: The time field is not tied to the calendar, so the picked day and typed time are never combined or saved.
a11y: The time field has a linked label and native keyboard entry, and days are real buttons; the chosen date is not announced outside the grid. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall black panel holds "November 2026" between two angle arrows, weekday initials and five weeks of numbers, then a hairline divider and a small "Enter time" caption. A wide rounded field with a clock glyph on its left holds a 12-hour time with AM/PM.
behaves: Pressing a day fills it with a white circle and clears the previous one; hovering leaves a softer ring. The time field accepts typed hours, minutes and seconds in place, each segment highlighting blue while it is edited. Nothing submits.
customise: The default time of 12:00:00 and the caption link are written in the file; day selection, month limits and field styling come from the shared calendar and input.
weight: light: One month grid and a native time field; nothing animates.
